prompt: Write a product description for a reusable steel water bottle. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. Your response must have exactly 5 lines, and every line must have exactly 6 words. Do not use any uppercase letters. Do not use any commas. Include the word "steel".

Write a poem about the harvest season. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. It must have exactly 7 lines, and the first letters of the lines, read from top to bottom, must spell HARVEST. Every line must have at most 8 words and must end with a period. Do not use the words "autumn" or "fall" anywhere, not even inside a longer word.

Invent a fictional novel and describe it. Respond with only a JSON object and nothing else. The object must have exactly these five keys: "title" (a string of at most 4 words), "year" (an integer from 1950 to 1999), "genres" (an array of exactly 3 strings, in alphabetical order), "available" (a boolean) and "rating" (an integer from 1 to 5).

Explain what a hash table is. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. Your response must be exactly 40 words long and must consist of exactly 2 sentences. Include both of the words "bucket" and "collision". Do not use any digits.

Give five tips for getting better rest at night. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. Write exactly 5 lines, one tip per line. The first line must have exactly 3 words, and each later line must have exactly one more word than the line before it. Use no uppercase letters and no punctuation marks of any kind. Do not use the word "sleep".

Write one sentence about sailors. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. The sentence must be exactly 8 words long, every word must begin with the letter s, and the sentence must end with a period. Put it on a single line.

Summarize how a proposal becomes binding in a typical parliament. Write exactly 3 paragraphs, separated by blank lines, with at most 90 words in total. The very first word of your response must be "First". The words "committee", "debate", "vote" and "signature" must all appear, and the first time each one appears must follow that order. Do not use the word "government".

Write a safety notice for a school chemistry lab. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. It must have exactly 4 lines. Every line must begin with the word RULE and have at most 7 words. Do not use any lowercase letters or any exclamation marks. Mention goggles.

Describe a small grocery trip. Your response must be exactly 2 sentences and at most 30 words. It must contain exactly three whole numbers written with digits (no decimals), and those three numbers must add up to exactly 100. No other digits may appear anywhere. Do not use the $ symbol.

Describe a thunderstorm. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. Your response must be a single line of exactly 25 words, and no word may be used more than once (ignoring capitalization). Do not use any commas. Include the word "lightning".

Describe a city at night. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. Write exactly 3 lines, each with at least 6 words. You must not use the letter e anywhere in your response, in either uppercase or lowercase. Include the word "taxi".

List six fruits. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. Write exactly 6 lines. Each line must have exactly 3 words: the name of a fruit followed by two words that describe it. The lines must be in alphabetical order by fruit name. Use no uppercase letters. Do not use "apple" or "banana".

Write release notes for version 2.0 of a note-taking app. Start with a title wrapped in double angular brackets, like <<title>>. Include exactly 4 bullet points in Markdown, each on its own line beginning with a hyphen. Highlight at least 2 phrases with Markdown emphasis, like *this*. Finish with a postscript that begins with P.S. Keep the whole response under 80 words, and do not use the word "bug", not even inside a longer word.

Write a dialogue between a customer and a barista. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. It must have exactly 6 lines. The lines must alternate speakers, starting with the customer: each of the customer's lines must begin with "Customer:" and each of the barista's lines with "Barista:". Every line must have at most 10 words, counting the speaker label as a word. The word "oat" must appear, and the very last character of your response must be a question mark.

Explain how to make a pot of tea. Respond with only a JSON object and nothing else. The object must have exactly two keys: "steps", an array of exactly 4 strings where each string has at most 6 words, and "minutes", an integer from 10 to 20. The word "boil" must appear somewhere in your response.

Invent three people and write them as records. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. Write exactly 3 lines and nothing else. Each line must have the form Name|Age|City with no spaces: Name and City are each a single word made of one capital letter followed by lowercase letters, and Age is a two-digit number. The lines must be in alphabetical order by Name, and the three ages must add up to exactly 100.

Write a short email politely declining a meeting invitation. Your response must begin with exactly "Dear Ms. Okafor," and must end with exactly "Regards, Sam". It must have exactly 3 paragraphs separated by blank lines (the greeting and the sign-off each count as a paragraph) and at most 70 words in total. Mention Thursday. Do not use the words "sorry" or "unfortunately".

Explain to a young child why things drop to the ground. A "line" means a non-blank line of your response, and a "word" means a run of characters separated by spaces. Use only words that are at most 5 letters long. Write exactly 3 sentences and at least 25 words. Do not use the word "force".

Give two different slogans for a bicycle shop. Separate the two slogans with a line containing exactly six asterisks (******) and write nothing else. Use no uppercase letters and no exclamation marks. The two slogans together must have at most 12 words, and the word "ride" must appear.

Write an announcement for a library book sale. It must be at most 140 characters long and at least 15 words long. It must mention the date "March 9", contain exactly one exclamation mark, and end with the hashtag #BookSale as its very last characters.
